[[Chef Armand]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Ferndale}} outside [[Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick)]]

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Fungal Wallow|Fungal wallow]]s are just the cutest creatures, aren't they? That's why I feel so guilty splitting open their bellies to get at the wonderful truffles inside them! You see, they consume great quantities of truffles daily to sate their voracious appetites, leaving little for you and I to feast on at the dining table. Some gourmands dislike the taste of, um, semi-digested fungus, but true connoisseurs appreciate the bold tastes and strong aromas of fungal wallow truffles. I know I do! Gather me 5 [[Truffle|truffle]]s in return for this..."''
